description.value: Taylor Public Library is a small community library serving the District of Taylor in Northern BC's Peace River region. It offers a range of public services including computer and internet access, interlibrary loans, photocopying, and programs for all ages. For touring cyclists passing through this remote northern corridor, it provides a welcoming public space with free Wi-Fi.
